title: Creamy Coleslaw
description: Crunchy shredded cabbage and carrots in a tangy, lightly sweet mayonnaise and cider vinegar dressing. Perfect with barbecue.

image.alt: A bowl of creamy coleslaw with shredded cabbage and carrot

steps.text: Whisk the mayonnaise, vinegar, sugar, mustard, salt and pepper in a large bowl.
Add the cabbage and carrots and toss until evenly coated.
Chill for at least {time 30 min notimer} so the cabbage softens slightly and the flavors blend. Toss again before serving.

notes: A bag of coleslaw mix saves all the shredding.
Keeps 2 days in the fridge; it gets softer and more watery the longer it sits.
